threadWidths.scope: Actual Windows Electron capture and geometry. Main 1920/1280/760px and quick 420px, light/dark, native 100/125/150% zoom as recorded. Main long tables expand from768 to864px at1920; quick compact tables remain prose width. Main scroll container is an independent implementation; all reference container ancestors, composer overhang, inline shifts/overrides and other DPI/OS are not restored or verified.
